how: RefineSystem keeps one chunk per sentence-batch; every cleaned sentence is added to the existing list on the Refine page, never replacing it (test/composer-flow.mjs proves it).
The basic working refinement (raw, clean, outline, scores) runs on the Refine page; this slice only changed how sentences accumulate.
Cleaning is instant per word and the live outline ticks per batch; a one-sentence utterance still waits about 8 s for its outline.
The live outline (LiveRefine) already amends incrementally; Refine now keeps earlier sentences while it does.
Per chunk: instant clean per word, outline per live batch, Refine per sent sentence. Cards per chunk are not built.
